alignn_ff_bcc_li.structure: bcc Li, JVASP-913 (JARVIS OptB88-vdW geometry), 2x2x2 supercell

e_li_reference.note: Voltages in this file use the ALIGNN-FF energy of bcc Li computed with the same calculator: single-point on the JVASP-913 geometry for level (a), FIRE-relaxed for level (b).  screen.py uses jarvis unary_energy('Li') (JARVIS OptB88-vdW DFT); dft_prep.py uses in-house Li_sv DFT values.  The choice shifts every voltage by a constant and does not affect any energy gap or ranking result.
